requirements.title: Channel Label & Inbound Direction
requirements.description: Channel label is 'adb-channel' (11 bytes), created by Browser Client and accepted inbound by Agent in pc.OnDataChannel.

requirements.title: Dispatcher & Handler Routing
requirements.description: Inbound dispatch compares label 'adb-channel' (ARM64 0x53f2ac, AMD64 0x9e2fad) and routes to dedicated adb handler (ARM64 0x516020, AMD64 0x9b2be0).

requirements.title: Lifecycle Callback Registration
requirements.description: Handler registers (*DataChannel).OnClose and (*DataChannel).OnMessage hooks; evaluates readyState on OnOpen; zero branch-specific OnError registered.

requirements.title: Session-Sticky Dual-Mode Persistence
requirements.description: First message evaluates length >= 24 and CNXN magic 0x4e584e43; permanently latches session into ADB_PACKET_MODE or BARE_RAW_PTY_MODE.

requirements.title: 24-Byte ADB Packet Header Layout & State Machine
requirements.description: ADB packet mode enforces 24-byte little-endian header layout and handles CNXN, OPEN, WRTE, CLSE, replying with OKAY, CNXN, or CLSE via (*DataChannel).Send.

requirements.title: Bare Raw PTY Mode Streaming
requirements.description: Non-CNXN first message logs 'First packet is not ADB, switching to BARE raw PTY mode' and forwards raw unencapsulated bytes between DataChannel and PTY descriptor.

requirements.title: In-Process PTY/Shell Spawner & Concurrency Pump
requirements.description: Downstream execution allocates local PTY (/dev/ptmx) or fallback pipes, spawns shell process (/system/bin/sh or /bin/sh), and pumps stdout via goroutine.

requirements.title: Absence of External TCP 127.0.0.1:5555 Bridge
requirements.description: Binary reachability analysis confirms zero reachable net.Dial calls from adb-channel handler; no external TCP bridge to 127.0.0.1:5555 exists in original agent.

requirements.title: Inbound Ordered Property Reference Classification
requirements.description: Inbound ordered=true is configured by browser client at creation and is classified as REFERENCE_ONLY from frontend evidence.

requirements.title: Standard ADB Protocol Specification Background
requirements.description: Standard Android ADB protocol documentation (A_CNXN, A_OPEN, A_OKAY, A_CLSE, A_WRTE field names) is classified as REFERENCE_BACKGROUND.

requirements.title: Deferred ADB Bridge Execution Boundary
requirements.description: All PTY allocation, process execution, and shell forwarder logic are classified as DEFERRED_ADB_BRIDGE_BOUNDARY and strictly excluded from clean-room agent runtime.

requirements.title: Production ADB Channel Inertness Guard
requirements.description: Reconstructed clean-room agent maintains adb-channel strictly inert with zero production OnMessage handlers, zero net.Dial calls, and zero shell execution.

requirements.title: Historical Errata and Superseded Evidence Recorded
requirements.description: Historical Phase 2C.5A artifacts remain immutable while formal errata superseding the '127.0.0.1:5555' external bridge claim are recorded in ADB_CHANNEL_B6F_CONTRACT_ERRATA.json.
